subtitle: Counted from our own records rather than an analytics tool, and published in full because the project is open source.
signed-in-only: Only signed-in readers are counted: an anonymous visit has no account to count it by. A reader who came on several days counts once in the weekly and monthly figures.
active-readers-last-30-days: Signed-in readers per day, last 30 days
activity-recorded-since: Readers are recorded as they come since {date}. The days before were rebuilt from the sessions still on record, so they show fewer readers than there were.
